name: Talon
description: A finely worked legendary blade tied to Aldith Tresendar.

name: Shield of Tyr
description: Carved with the god's image.

name: +1 shield
description: Francis bought it from Lenine and passed it to Broc after finding the Shield of Tyr.

name: Choppy
description: Levon's greataxe. After he carved an oddly grained sapling, the same pale pattern appeared in the handle, which is now warm to the touch.

found.where: Upgraded at camp outside Wave Echo Cave

name: Carved wooden tree
description: Recreates a pattern from a tree Levon once cut down.

name: Cloak of Protection
description: Tharden's cloak, given away by Gundren. Gives +1 AC and +1 to saving throws. Sized for a dwarf.

name: Wand of Magic Missiles
description: No attunement needed.

found.where: Sunken skeleton in the black pool, Wave Echo Cave

name: Candle of the Deep
description: Keeps burning underwater.

name: The cook's second-best ladle
description: Prize for winning the festival cooking contest.

name: The Golden Ladle
description: Festival award for best dish, given with a jar of the cook's spice rub.

name: Big Hollis's rope bracelet
description: Festival award for the mightiest single pull in the tug of war.

name: Unwavering compass
description: Francis hinted at treasure stories to get it down from 18 tickets to 9. Whether any festival prize means anything is unknown.

name: Portrait of the stranger
description: Shows Scringle McGruffle, a thief from Waterdeep. Bought for 5 tickets.

name: Lucky deck of 51 cards
description: Bought for 8 tickets without haggling.

name: Giant stuffed owlbear plush
description: Blue sweet-talked Corwin into selling it for 18 tickets, which won her the Silver Tongue of the Fair.

name: Singing stone (Allyanna's)
description: Allyanna haggled the price down.

name: Singing stone (Broc's)
description: Bought for 10 tickets after Corwin recognized him.

name: Tin whistle
description: Bought for 6 tickets.

name: Sylvan Talon Dagger
description: Helps communicate with fey and carries short magical messages (Message).

name: Nezznar's spider staff
description: Black staff topped with a carved spider. Deals extra poison damage, with charges for Spider Climb and Web.

name: Hat of Wizardry
description: A wizard focus that gives a chance to cast a wizard cantrip he doesn't know.

name: Scroll of Remove Curse
description: From Garaele's contacts, meant for Francis. Vexhar is trying to copy it, and the scroll is destroyed either way.

name: Potion of invisibility
description: From the cistern satchel under Tresendar Manor.

name: Drowned Pan Flute
description: Casts Fly, Invisibility, Levitate, Protection from Evil and Good, Barkskin, Cure Wounds and Fog Cloud, each once per long rest. Hums an unfinished tune even when she isn't playing it.

name: Allyanna's staff
description: Lets her cast Shield.

name: Dust of Dryness
description: Absorbs large amounts of water and can harm water creatures.

name: Wooden pipe with platinum filigree
description: From Mormesk's chest.

name: Fancy ale mug
description: A gift from Broc. Not magic.

name: Cloak of the Manta Ray
description: Underwater breathing and swimming.

name: Three jeweled gold rings
description: Not magical, and the forge didn't enchant them.

name: Solid iron bar
description: From the smelter.

name: Jade statuette
description: From Klarg's chest.

name: Three poisoned arrows
description: Greenish coating, taken from hobgoblins.

name: Flashback Reroll tokens
description: Each is tied to specific skills from that character's flashback.
